Article 24(5) obliges providers of online platforms to submit anonymised versions of such statements of reasons to a publicly accessibly database hosted by the Commission (The DSA Transparency Database), to establish a public track record of the content moderation decisions taken by online platforms for the monitoring of illegal and harmful content online.
